title: ML4 Opens Weights for New AI Model Focused on Cyber and Coding Tasks
summary:
The weights for the ML4 artificial intelligence system have been released to the public, providing external access to a model designed for frontier capabilities in cybersecurity and the creation of code agents. This version of the model is more compact and efficient than the ML4 preview build that was made available three weeks ago.

The release is accompanied by a technical report that outlines the model's training and the relationship between its pretraining architecture and agentic performance. The documentation also explains the developer's use of infinite post-training data loops to refine the system.
